Chief Complaint: Shortness of breath on exertion and intermittent chest pain over the past two weeks.

Assessment/History:
Patient reports shortness of breath on exertion and intermittent chest pain over the past two weeks. Started aspirin 81 milligrams daily for stable angina.

Physical Exam/Vitals:
Heart rate is 88 and regular. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally.

Review of Systems/History:
Hypertension review on 2026-01-14; blood pressure controlled on amlodipine 5 mg; advised salt restriction and follow-up in three months.

Plan/Orders:
Ordering of an electrocardiogram and a troponin level.
